text:
eli: Quick sketch: create an endpoint shadow cache in the control plane that mirrors tenant endpoint metadata (IPs, attachment-state, peering flags, certs) and exposes a delta stream for relays. The idea is to make peering/attachment transitions visible to relays quickly without full controlplane RPCs.

marta: Love the idea. Main risk is divergence during peering cutovers — relays might route to an endpoint that's already detached. How do we gate reads during change windows?

kevin: idea: include a change_state field (pending|committed|staging). On peering flip we write staging->committed after infra confirms route propagation. Relays ignore staging unless an emergency flag is set.

ryan: perf/scale: storing every endpoint event is heavy. We should store current item + small watermark history (last 3 transitions) as plain CSV in a field so relays can surface flaps. Don't add nested objects.

eli: agreed. proto item (flat form):
```
account_id: acct_98
endpoint_id: ep-77
region: eu-central-1
addresses: 10.2.4.9,10.2.4.10
cert_sha256: sha256:abcd
state: committed
version: 124
last_seen_ts: 3781234500
tags: privatelink,peered
```

marta: We also need monotonic version per-account to handle reorders. If relay receives version <= current ignore.

kevin: transport: Kinesis/Kafka per-region with per-account partition by account_id. Relays maintain per-account cursor to resume. For controlplane writes from infra operators ensure idempotent writes with CAS on version.

ryan: auth: heartbeats from customer agents or relay-proxy will use short-lived certs (mTLS) minted by onboarding flow. Writes from controlplane only via signed internal tokens. Audit log required.

ops-bot: infra-alert: detected high write rate for tenant=big-retailer at 3781234600, suggest rate-limit and notify on-call

eli: migration plan:
- 1) read-only mirror: build stream consumer that materializes current items into mirror table
- 2) relay feature-flag: relays can read mirror with fallback to controlplane RPC
- 3) enable staged writes for a small canary set and validate via simulated peering flips
- 4) increase rollout based on SLOs

marta: SLOs: 99th percentile registry-to-relay delta < 2s, registry_write_success >= 99.9%. Alert if lag > 5s.

kevin: ops: implement backpressure: if stream lag > threshold relays should fallback to controlplane queries and mark mirror degraded. Also quorum check for cross-region: if majority of regional mirrors disagree, prefer controlplane.

ryan: cost optimization: adaptive sampling + event suppression for noisy endpoints. Default heartbeat 30s, aggressive 5s during transitions, allow tenant opt-in for 1s fidelity.

eli: security note: registry is NOT authoritative for network policy. Controlplane infra datastore is the source of truth for attachments, routes, and peering. Mirror is advisory for routing & observability only.

marta: next steps: I can take the consumer and canary automation. Kevin will prototype CAS writes. Ryan will draft auth + audit plan. Eli will author RFC and checklist.

ops-bot: task-create: ARCH-998 add endpoint-shadow PoC, due 3781238400

eli: thanks all. I'll open the RFC PR and tag the network + oncall channels. :shipit:
